[Two Hours a Week](https://gregpallone.substack.com/p/two-hours-a-week), by
Greg Pallone on Substack, 1 September 2026.

**Cardio and resistance training both help, and neither needs much time: 60 to
90 minutes a week of resistance training, in two sessions, could be enough.**
The post reports a Harvard cohort study in the *British Journal of Sports
Medicine* that followed 147,374 adults for up to 30 years.

- **Resistance training.** All-cause mortality was lowest at 90 to 120 minutes
  a week, about 13% below people who did none. Past 120 minutes the benefit
  stopped growing.
- **Both together.** Combining resistance and aerobic exercise was associated
  with a 45% lower mortality, more than either one alone.
